name: Kevin Huang
evidence: GitHub code search for the project title returned 0 results. One WebSearch located the underlying work: 'Cultural bias and cultural alignment of large language models' (Tao, Viberg, Baker, Kizilcec; KTH/Cornell/UPenn, arXiv 2311.14096 / PNAS Nexus), where a Kevin Huang is credited in the acknowledgements for initial help writing the evaluation script - consistent with the row's project listing, but acknowledgements carry no address. No page printing an email for this Kevin Huang (Swedbank, Stockholm) was retrievable; aclanthology/arxiv/pmc and personal sites are blocked by the egress policy.
